description: This Dart file defines the application's theme styles for a Flutter app, including color schemes, widget themes, and utility functions for light and dark themes, following the Ocean Professional style.

classes.name: _OceanColors
classes.description: Contains predefined color constants used across the theme for both light and dark modes.

methods.name: oceanHeaderGradient
methods.description: Creates a BoxDecoration with a gradient for headers or containers based on theme context.

methods.name: _cardShape
methods.description: Returns a RoundedRectangleBorder with configured corner radius for card shapes.

methods.name: _outlinedBorder
methods.description: Returns an OutlineInputBorder with a specified color and consistent corner radius.

methods.name: _filledButtonStyle
methods.description: Creates an ElevatedButton style with specified background and foreground colors.

methods.name: _lightScheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ColorScheme used for the light theme.

methods.name: _darkScheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ColorScheme used for the dark theme.

methods.name: getAppTheme
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData object configured for the application's light theme.

methods.name: getDarkTheme
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData object configured for the application's dark theme.
